newsitem.title: GERMANY: Buba's Sievert - current dlr/dmk rate acceptable.
newsitem.headline: Buba's Sievert - current dlr/dmk rate acceptable.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Olaf Sievert said on Tuesday that the current exchange rates between the mark and international currencies including the dollar were acceptable.

"The mark's valuation on international forex markets now better reflects fundamental conditions than it did a year ago," Sievert said in a speech at a ceremony of the state central bank of Saxony and Thuringia, of which he is president.
"We can live with the current exchange rates, even with the U.S. dollar," he said.
Sievert added however that he would "certainly have no problem" with a slightly stronger dollar, since this would improve jobs prospects in Germany and Europe.
